{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and the conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_fraction = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print both values exactly as they will appear in evidence
print(n_loyal)
print(conversion_fraction)"}
